title: Autism Measurement Ranged Fivefold Across Screening Sites
hook: Where children are screened can radically change the reported autism rate.
closing: Autism rates need screening context before anyone treats one number as universal.
question: Has screening changed near you?

segments.say: Autism prevalence reached 32.2 per thousand children, rising sharply across the recorded years.
Autism prevalence among boys measured 49.2 per thousand, revealing a large difference by sex.
The California autism site measured 52.6 per thousand, showing location can sharply change the reported rate.
